summary: Techstars has current public accelerator applications listed. A concrete current event is the Techstars New York City Accelerator September 2026 cohort, with applications open Mar 2, 2026 and final deadline Jun 10, 2026.

proposed_event.name: Techstars New York City Accelerator (Fall 2026)
proposed_event.description: Hybrid 3-month NYC accelerator with $220k investment, mentorship, network access and partner perks.

sources.title: Techstars New York City Accelerator
sources.supports: Official NYC accelerator page supports the program name, New York location, hybrid format, application dates Mar 2 and Jun 10 2026, accelerator start Sep 8 2026, demo day Dec 10 2026, focus areas, investment amount, mentorship, perks, and network access.

sources.title: Techstars Accelerators
sources.supports: Official accelerator directory supports that Techstars runs three-month accelerator programs offering product-market fit support, capital, mentorship, and current applications including NYC with an Apply by Jun 10 listing.

sources.title: Techstars Investment Terms Update
sources.supports: Official investment terms update supports the current $220,000 accelerator investment structure and 3-month mentorship-driven accelerator benefit.

notes: Techstars is a family of city and vertical accelerators with separate pages and dates; this record uses the current NYC Fall 2026 cohort as a concrete mergeable event.

The official accelerator directory also lists multiple other programs with the same Jun 10, 2026 application deadline, including Anywhere, AI Health Baltimore, Alabama EnergyTech, Boulder, Columbus, Future of Food, Space, and others.
Older existing Spring 2026 Techstars entries are stale as of 2026-06-09 unless retained as past cohorts.
